```{=html}
<section class="band band-slim band-green">
  <div class="band-narrow">

    <p class="eyebrow-lg">Questions</p>

    <p class="date-place" style="text-transform:none; letter-spacing:0.04em; font-size:1rem; margin-top:1.4rem">
      Everything we have been asked so far. If your question is not here, just text or email
      either of us &mdash; we would rather answer it than have you wonder.
    </p>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-cream">
  <div class="band-inner">

    <div class="faq-list">

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>What should we wear?</h4>
        <p>The dress code is still being settled and we will post it here.
        <span class="pending">One thing we can tell you now:</span> the ceremony is on the lawn,
        so stilettos and soft June grass will not get along. Block heels or flats will make your
        night much better.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>Is the ceremony outside?</h4>
        <p>Yes &mdash; on the lawn looking out over Cayuta Lake. If the weather turns, we move
        under a tent on the property, so the day happens rain or shine either way.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>What time should we arrive?</h4>
        <p>Plan on getting there about thirty minutes before the ceremony so you have time to
        park, find a drink, and sit down without rushing. The exact start time will be on your
        invitation.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>Is there a shuttle?</h4>
        <p>There is. It runs from downtown Ithaca out to the Inn before the ceremony, then makes
        an early and a late return trip back downtown. Pickup spot and times will be posted on the
        <a href="travel.html">Travel &amp; Stay</a> page closer to the date.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>Where should we stay?</h4>
        <p>Most people are staying in downtown Ithaca, which is where the shuttle runs from. We
        are not holding a room block, so book early &mdash; June fills up. All our
        recommendations, including bed and breakfasts closer to the venue, are on the
        <a href="travel.html">Travel &amp; Stay</a> page.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>Can I bring a guest?</h4>
        <p>Your invitation will name everyone we have saved a seat for. If you are unsure after it
        arrives, ask us &mdash; it is never an awkward question.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>Are kids welcome?</h4>
        <p>Yes. There will be a kids' meal option, and there is plenty of room to run around.
        Taughannock, the Sciencenter, and the farmers market all make good use of a morning &mdash;
        see <a href="things-to-do.html">Things to Do</a>.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>When do we need to RSVP?</h4>
        <p>Invitations go out in early spring 2027 and the RSVP deadline will be on them. You do
        not need to do anything before that.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>I have a dietary restriction.</h4>
        <p>Tell us when you RSVP &mdash; there is a place for it. Our caterer handles vegetarian,
        vegan, gluten-free, and allergies routinely, and every dish at dinner is labelled.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>Is there parking at the venue?</h4>
        <p>Yes, there is plenty of parking at the Inn. If you would rather not drive at the end of
        the night, take the shuttle &mdash; that is exactly what it is for.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>When does the night end?</h4>
        <p>The reception wraps up around eleven. For anyone staying on the estate or nearby, there
        is a bonfire afterward.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>What is the weather like in June?</h4>
        <p>Usually beautiful &mdash; warm days in the seventies and evenings that cool off more
        than people expect near the water. Bring a layer for after sunset.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>Where should we fly into?</h4>
        <p>Ithaca Tompkins (ITH) is closest, about forty minutes out. Syracuse (SYR) and Elmira
        (ELM) are each roughly an hour and a half and usually cheaper with more flights. You will
        want a car from any of them.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item">
        <h4>Is there a registry?</h4>
        <p>There is, on <a href="registry.html">Zola</a> &mdash; though your being there is
        genuinely the part we care about.</p>
      </div>

    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band script-banner">
  <div class="plaque">
    <p>We cannot wait to see all of you in June.</p>
  </div>
</section>
```
